senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of στρατιώτης, v. אִסְרַדְיוֹט) Roman or Greek officer, captain.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:28">Tosef. Succ. IV, 28</cite>; Y. ib. V, end, 55ᵈ; Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:6">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>כמי שנמסר לס׳</he> as if given in charge of an officer (to be brought before court).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:17">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>למחר קומיס ולמחר ס׳</he> the next day one is a comes, the next day he may be (degraded to be) captain; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְרַדְיוֹטוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a:13">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>שלחה מלכות הרשעה שני ס׳</he> Ms. M. (not <he>סרדיוטת</he>; Ar. <he>סְרַדְיוֹטָאוֹת</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the wicked (Roman) government sent two commissioners &c. (to study the Jewish law); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 341">Yalk. Ex. 341</cite> <cite ref="O01194"><he>סנדריוטי</he></cite> (read: <cite ref="O01541"><he>סְרַדְיוֹטִין</he></cite>); <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 344:4">Sifré Deut. 344</cite> <he>סרדיטאות</he> (corr. acc.); (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:3:3">Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ</cite> <he>אִיסְרַטְיוֹטוֹת</he>).—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8:2">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite> <he>להביא אותה סרדיוטות</he>, read: <he>אותם דּוֹרוֹנוֹת</he> or <cite ref="D00366"><he>דּוֹרָיוֹת</he></cite>.]
